about: The most damage at which a standing character that holds the C-stick down through the hit's freeze (ASDI down) is on the floor when it ends when hit by an opponent's move from a distance (units): null not hit, -1 not even at 0%, 260 still at 260%. tools/melee_drills/cc_limits.py --asdi; hitlag: the freeze in frames; lifts: whether the hit lifts it at 0% when it holds nothing
